data_basis: Frozen case-by-seed witness outcomes; NOT new runs or operational batches

interpretation.all_hit: Every positive case retains at least one witness; not every metric or every query is preserved
interpretation.changes: 0 new sources, seeds, model/query/packing calls or environment changes
interpretation.costs: Within the fixed experimental budget/representation; no measured operational cost objective
interpretation.first_order: A property of the empirical distributions only; no population dominance test
interpretation.inference: Post-hoc endpoint analysis; not a future risk estimate, operational utility, or p-value
interpretation.utility_class: Symmetric functions of the number of witness-positive cases; no identities or per-case weights
interpretation.weighting: 16 existing labels have equal empirical weight within a panel; panels are not pooled
